definitions.explanation: A young bird that has recently hatched or has not yet learned to fly.

examples.english: There are chicks in the nest.

examples.japanese: {雛鳥|ひなどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{親鳥|おやどり}→親鳥：25490_oyadori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧エサ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらっている→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The chick is being fed by its parent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧{雛鳥|ひなどり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{触|さわ}らない→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I found a chick that had fallen from its nest, but was told it's better not to touch it.

notes:
Refers to any young bird, from just hatched to fledgling stage. Can also be used figuratively to describe someone young and inexperienced.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雛鳥|ひなどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{孵|かえ}る: a chick hatches
- {雛鳥|ひなどり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise a chick
- {雛鳥|ひなどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{巣立|すだ}つ→巣立つ：27798_sudatsu⟧: a fledgling leaves the nest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ひよこ→ひよこ：10501_hiyoko⟧: chick (especially a newly hatched domestic fowl; also used as a cute term)
- ⟦{幼鳥|ようちょう}→幼鳥：26318_youchou⟧: young bird (more scientific/formal)
- ⟦{親鳥|おやどり}→親鳥：25490_oyadori⟧: parent bird (opposite)
